rules.sentence: In terms of the DSM-5 diagnostic criteria, 59 participants had normal cognition, 28 had mild neurocognitive disorder (mild NCD), and 31 had major NCD or dementia.
To discriminate between those with and without dementia, the AUC was 0.893.
A cutoff of 4 maximized the Youden index, with a more balanced sensitivity of 0.77 and specificity of 0.86.
A cutoff of 2 resulted in a higher sensitivity of 0.90 and a lower specificity of 0.60 (Table 4 and Fig 3).
